what_works: Heavy condensed all-caps display type repeated rhythmically as a structural device — the wordmark itself becomes the layout grid. Crimson accent against deep black creates tension without color noise.
what_does_not_translate: Punk-edge portraiture and festival imagery are off-tone for trades; keep the structural type rhythm, drop the subculture photography.
type_observations: Single condensed sans (Druk-style) in heavy weight doing all the work — display and body share a family, scale carries hierarchy.
